---
name: Data or reproducibility question
about: Ask about corpus preparation, model outputs or a recorded result.
title: "[Reproducibility] "
---

## Question

Which field, equation, command, metric or recorded run are you asking about?

## Context

Include the commit, variant, source versions, split or schedule ID, and the corpus hash if relevant. For metrics, include the support or contra channel and the candidate counts. Use synthetic IDs in examples and keep licensed records and private credentials local.
